review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description: We are looking for an experienced Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) Software Engineer to support the development, maintenance, and enhancement of our Bluetooth software stack. In this role, you will troubleshoot and resolve complex BLE issues, implement new Bluetooth features, and work closely with customers and internal engineering teams to deliver robust wireless connectivity solutions. Key Responsibilities: Support and enhance Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) Host and Controller stack components, including GAP, GATT, and LE Audio profiles. Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve customer-reported Bluetooth issues across embedded platforms. Design, develop, integrate, and debug Bluetooth firmware and drivers using C/C++. Perform interoperability testing, analyze Bluetooth packets using tools such as Frontline and Ellisys protocol analyzers, and support Bluetooth qualification activities. Optimize system performance by improving throughput, reducing latency, and enhancing power efficiency. Collaborate with global engineering teams and customers to investigate and resolve complex technical issues. Ensure implementations comply with Bluetooth SIG specifications and industry best practices. Qualifications/Requirements: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline. 10+ years of experience in embedded firmware development using C/C++. Strong understanding of the Bluetooth Core Specification. Hands-on experience with Bluetooth Low Energy Controller and Host Stack development. Experience with Bluetooth Low Energy profiles and application development. Strong debugging skills involving wireless baseband, Bluetooth protocol timing, and non-deterministic issues. Proficiency with Bluetooth protocol analyzers (Frontline, Ellisys), logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and embedded debugging tools. Experience with RTOS, embedded SDKs, and embedded system design.

review_candidates.title: Sr. .NET Full Stack Developer.
review_candidates.description: Lumin Soft is a leading Software House in Egypt, specializing in IT consulting, custom software development, Portals, Mobile Applications, testing, Data Science, AI, ERP/CRM, and UX/UI design. The company, founded 20 years ago in 2002 as Excel Systems, is now recognized as a key one-stop shop for software solutions, serving both Egyptian and global markets. Lumin Soft is known for its high-quality products, client satisfaction, timely delivery, and competitive pricing. Role Description We are looking for a Senior .NET Full Stack Developer to build scalable and high-performing software solutions. You'll be part of a cross-functional team responsible for the full software development lifecycle from system design to deployment and post-release support. Key Responsibilities Design and develop scalable client-side and server-side architecture Build responsive, visually appealing user interfaces Develop and manage robust databases and back-end applications Build secure and well-documented RESTful APIs Perform testing and optimization for responsiveness and performance Debug and upgrade legacy systems Implement security and data protection best practices Collaborate in Agile teams and contribute to sprint planning and retrospectives Write and maintain technical documentation Qualifications Minimum 4 years of experience as a Full Stack Developer Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field Strong proficiency in C# and .NET Core Hands-on experience with Angular or similar front-end frameworks Experience working with Microservices architecture is a MUST Solid knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript Familiarity with databases such as MS SQL and MongoDB Minimum 1 years of experience in Agile environments
